channel.title: Auralis Release Notes
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 1.1.3
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.3

  • Fix intelligence mode: use simi_song API for song-based recommendations without requiring playlist context
  • Fix repeat-one mode: replay current song on track end, next, and previous
  • Fix lyric highlighting not resetting when repeating the same song in full-screen player

item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.2

  • MV 播放器: Click recommended MVs on Explore to play in a full-screen native video player
  • 原生视频渲染: AVPlayerView with custom overlay controls, auto-hide on playback
  • 按钮点击区域优化: Expanded hit areas across all player controls for easier interaction
  • 修复 MV 播放器退出后卡死问题

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.1

  • 心动模式 (Intelligence Mode): Smart recommendations based on current song
  • 音质选择 (Audio Quality): Choose from Standard to Master quality in Settings
  • 全屏播放器动画优化: Smoother transitions with staggered animations
  • 歌词交互: Click any lyric line to seek, hover effects for better UX
  • 修复全屏播放器进度条颜色突变问题
  • i18n 修复: Sidebar and Explore section headers now properly localized
  • 更换全新 Auralis 应用图标与项目标识
